findings.title: HPA is switched off: its target is scaled to zero
findings.cause: HPA web does not scale Deployment web: the Deployment has 0 replicas, and an HPA leaves a workload at zero alone, so it stays at zero whatever the load

evidence.detail: scaling is disabled since the replica count of the target is zero

evidence.command: kubectl get deployment web -n kd-hpa-target-scaled-to-zero -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}'

findings.fix: Scale Deployment web to 1 or more replicas and the HPA takes over again. If its manifest says replicas: 0, drop the replicas field, so applying the manifest does not undo what the HPA sets.
